description:
Main Street ROI is a digital marketing agency based in New York serving small businesses, marketing managers, and marketing consultants.

Our services include: search engine optimization (SEO) with a focus on Local SEO, pay per click (PPC) management including Google Ads (AdWords) and Facebook Ads, and social media marketing services.

Our mission is to help all businesses succeed with online marketing. That's why we also offer free webinars and affordable training programs to teach internet marketing best practices. Since 2010, we’ve helped thousands of businesses create profitable marketing campaigns.

Call (646) 470-3753 to speak with a Main Street ROI marketing advisor.

[{"id": "3307103138594237245", "text": "If you've been investing in SEO for a couple of months and you're wondering why you're not on page one yet, you're not behind. You're on schedule.

SEO is a slow cooker. Even Google says it takes four to twelve months to see meaningful results. And that's with consistent effort the entire time.

That timeline frustrates a lot of small business owners, especially when you're paying for it monthly and the phone isn't ringing yet. But the businesses that stick with it are the ones that eventually have a steady stream of leads coming in without paying per click.

Three things determine how fast you'll see results: how much quality content you're producing, how strong your technical foundation is, and how far ahead your competitors are. If a competitor has been publishing weekly for three years and you just started, you have catching up to do. But if their content is thin and yours is genuinely helpful, it takes less time than you'd think.

Our latest article breaks down what actually affects how long SEO takes to work, so you can set realistic expectations and know whether your campaign is on track. ⏳", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipP55jBrMooEZrlYtgYMfnjV6BgavzUxZ9SJPABK=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://www.mainstreetroi.com/how-long-does-seo-take-to-work/", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2026-09-28T15:00:58", "expires_at": "2027-03-30T15:00:57", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "8526257143424461847", "text": "Most small business owners know SEO matters but have no idea whether their website is actually set up correctly for it.

The good news is you don't need to hire someone just to find out. You can check the most important factors yourself in about 16 minutes.

Things like whether your page titles include the keywords you want to rank for. Whether your meta descriptions are compelling enough to earn clicks. Whether your site has broken links, duplicate content, or slow load speeds dragging down your rankings.

None of these are complicated to check, and most of them are easy to fix once you spot them. The hard part is just knowing where to look.

Our latest article walks through an 8-step SEO audit you can do yourself in about 2 minutes per step. Think of it as a quick checkup before deciding whether you need a deeper diagnosis. ⏱️", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipNT8fUAgpA9Huqkb2s8L8Px5Ll8avAXzfUnDFkf=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://www.mainstreetroi.com/the-16-minute-seo-audit/", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2026-09-25T15:01:03", "expires_at": "2027-03-27T15:01:01", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "2035569332655928843", "text": "You launch a campaign, spend money for a few weeks, and then someone asks, "Is it working?"

And you realize you're not sure how to answer that question.

This happens to small businesses all the time. The campaign is running, money is being spent, but nobody defined what success looks like before they started. So now you're guessing based on gut feel instead of measuring based on data.

The fix is simple but easy to skip: decide how you'll measure success before you launch. Are you tracking online sales? Form submissions? Phone calls? Even website engagement can tell you something useful if you know what to look for.

Not every campaign leads directly to a sale either, and that's fine. Some campaigns build awareness. Some drive traffic that converts later. The key is knowing which type of campaign you're running and measuring it accordingly.

Our latest article breaks down 9 specific methods for measuring digital marketing success, split between direct conversions and website behavior metrics. 📊", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipMUCZWIaFTeVOswoB07ucHwyW07zL2VqaCsUi8S=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://www.mainstreetroi.com/9-ways-to-measure-digital-marketing-success/", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2026-09-21T15:00:51", "expires_at": "2027-03-23T15:00:49", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "5165227067858879359", "text": "Do you think it's worth sending an email to a list of 45 people?

Most business owners would say no. It feels too small to matter.

One of our clients, a chiropractor, had exactly 45 prospective patients on their list. We sent a simple 3-part email sequence promoting a first-time patient offer. Plain text emails, nothing fancy.

The result was just over $1,000 in new business. From 45 contacts.

We see the same pattern with cold lists too. Another client had 14,000 customers they hadn't emailed in over two years. The list felt worthless. We ran a short warm-up sequence to re-introduce the brand, let people opt out if they wanted, and then sent a simple promotion.

That campaign generated over $20,000 in sales.

The point isn't the specific numbers. It's that most businesses are sitting on an email list right now that they've written off as too small or too inactive to use. Our latest article walks through both of these case studies and what you can learn from them. 📧", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipMYAnzlhHx-ys5iUkXcgL5U1t3ZApj50vk4YjKd=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://www.mainstreetroi.com/2-email-marketing-case-studies-that-prove-no-list-is-too-small-or-too-cold/", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2026-09-18T15:00:39", "expires_at": "2027-03-20T15:00:37", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "6732304730386559830", "text": "Getting started on Google Ads takes about 15 minutes. Google has made it incredibly easy. A few clicks, a credit card, and your ads are live.

Getting results from Google Ads? That's a different story.

The gap between "I'm running ads" and "I'm getting leads and sales from my ads" is where most small businesses get stuck. And the challenges aren't always obvious until you're already spending money.

Things like choosing keywords that attract tire kickers instead of buyers. Sending ad traffic to your homepage instead of a targeted landing page. Running campaigns without conversion tracking, so you have no idea which ads are actually working.

None of these are hard to fix once you know what to look for. But if you don't know to look for them, they'll quietly drain your budget month after month.

Our latest article walks through 10 of the most common Google Ads challenges small businesses face and how to get past each one. 💡", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipNjp0d1Sw7z0PBvWRLfZ7a6W5CFq7PX4MjJZaVO=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://www.mainstreetroi.com/10-adwords-challenges-for-small-businesses-and-how-to-overcome-them/", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2026-09-14T15:01:27", "expires_at": "2027-03-16T15:01:26", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "2104654318594811881", "text": "There's no "one trick" that made this Google Ads campaign 33% cheaper per lead.

I know that's not the headline most people want to hear. We all want the silver bullet. The one change that fixes everything.

But that's not how Google Ads optimization actually works.

This case study is a dentist in Georgia who came to us advertising on his own with no conversion tracking. He didn't know which campaigns were working, which keywords were driving calls, or where his budget was being wasted.

We started by setting up proper tracking. Then, over several months, we made continuous improvements across the entire account: ad scheduling, device bids, budget allocation across campaigns, keyword-level adjustments, and ad copy testing.

No single change was the breakthrough. But added together, month after month, cost per lead dropped from $48 to $32. With the same quarterly budget, that's 51 more leads every quarter.

The Japanese call this Kaizen: continuous improvement. It's not flashy, but it works. 📉", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipPAc6lm5UF0V4mNlNAdqIe0szYwLvkInvSyL4z2=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://www.mainstreetroi.com/adwords-case-study-33-reduction-in-cost-per-lead-using-the-kaizen-approach/", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2026-09-07T18:00:33", "expires_at": "2027-03-09T18:00:31", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "4303502869396311320", "text": "You've gotten those LinkedIn messages from companies you've never heard of, asking for 15 minutes of your time. That gap between "delete" and "actually read it" is the core problem with how most businesses run LinkedIn Ads. They pick one approach: either cold messages that get ignored, or feed content that builds visibility but never converts into a real conversation.

Over the past couple of years running LinkedIn Ads campaigns, we found that the best results come from running both at the same time. The feed builds familiarity. The message starts the conversation. And when both tracks run together, they make each other work harder.

We wrote a new article introducing The Dual Track Approach, the strategy behind running feed ads and message ads as one coordinated system instead of two separate campaigns. 💬", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipNLhHNab6OR6vyA5gwPWTJnNZ9JDmix-o1LEizS=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://www.mainstreetroi.com/dual-track-approach-linkedin-ads/", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2026-09-04T14:00:43", "expires_at": "2027-03-06T14:00:41", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "3367415208038619706", "text": "If you run a local business, when was the last time you actually checked your Google Business Profile?

We do SEO audits regularly, and nearly 100% of the businesses we review are making at least one of the mistakes in this article. Usually more than one.

The good news is most of them are easy to fix once you know what to look for. Things like missing categories on your Google Business Profile, inconsistent contact information across directories, or a website with thin content that isn't giving Google enough to work with.

Some of these take 20 minutes to fix. Others take a longer investment. But all of them are costing you visibility in local search results right now.

Our latest article walks through 11 of the most common local SEO mistakes we see, what causes each one, and how to clean them up. Think of it as a self-audit checklist for your local search presence. ✅", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipPTnAI0w1A0G-Dx6WK5feTvpNUxfbJ5qWRKwzUN=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://www.mainstreetroi.com/local-seo-mistakes/", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2026-08-31T18:00:24", "expires_at": "2027-03-02T18:00:22", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "2691933766611167406", "text": "Many small business owners we work with have spent money on some form of offline marketing at some point. A print ad, a mailer, a sponsorship, a radio spot.

And when we ask how it went, the answer is almost always the same: "I think we got a few calls from it, but I'm not really sure."

That uncertainty is one of the biggest reasons to shift your marketing budget online. With digital marketing, you can see exactly what's working and what isn't. You can track which campaigns are driving leads, which emails are generating sales, and which pages on your website are converting visitors into customers.

That doesn't mean every digital channel will work for every business. But it does mean you'll know, and you can adjust based on real data instead of gut feel.

Our latest article walks through five specific reasons small businesses benefit from increasing their digital marketing budget, from higher ROI to better audience targeting to easier follow-up with prospects. 📊", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipOzD7CxsLhHbrMTVVQbqkV8ZTtlAUF1yfX2v4Mb=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://www.mainstreetroi.com/importance-of-digital-marketing-5-reasons-to-start-a-digital-marketing-budget/", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2026-08-28T15:00:35", "expires_at": "2027-02-27T15:00:34", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "3246278520384419262", "text": "Meta and Google keep making it easier to run ads. A few clicks, let the AI handle the targeting, the copy, the bidding. It sounds great.

But have you noticed that the easier these platforms get, the harder it is to see what's actually happening inside your campaigns?

You might not know which audiences are seeing your ads, why one campaign is getting more budget than another, or whether the platform is optimizing for your best customers or just the cheapest conversions.

We call this The Black Box Problem. And it's getting worse as these platforms hand more control to their own AI.

Here's the thing to remember: Google and Meta are optimizing to make their business more money. They don't want you to fail, because then you'd stop spending. But there's a wide range between "not failing" and getting the most out of every dollar you spend.

[{"id": "3146057894971507380", "text": "💡 "We want bold, innovative ideas!"

The innovation funnel: "Great. Let's remove all the risky parts first." 😂
Sometimes the idea doesn't fail because it was bad—it gets watered down until there's nothing left to differentiate it.

Playing it safe can be the riskiest move of all. 👀

", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipPfv6oeAimDBt5Wg9fnx3HtqMlRJyImpfxlysgB=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": null, "cta_label": null, "posted_at": "2026-09-25T14:03:20", "expires_at": "2027-03-27T14:03:19", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "13444621468263646", "text": "⚾ You can't win the marketing game with just one player.

Advertising. Promotion. Publicity. PR. Sales.

They may have different jobs, but they're all playing toward the same goal: getting your brand noticed, remembered, and chosen.

Think of your marketing strategy like a baseball team. Every player has a position—and the game works better when everyone knows theirs.

Marketing isn't one move. It's the whole playbook.

What’s missing from your marketing lineup? ⚾ 

", "type": "update", "image": null, "title": null, "cta_url": null, "cta_label": null, "posted_at": "2026-09-23T14:02:40", "expires_at": "2027-03-25T14:02:40", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "8754716133949501955", "text": " ✨ From the archive: a little luxury on four wheels. 🚘

Ritzy Rentals specializes in luxury car rentals, so we explored different logo concepts designed to capture that premium feel.

🏆 Which one would you put on a luxury car? Tell us your pick and why! 👇

It'll make your life easier."


Also 🤖: "Wait… does this look AI-generated?" 😂


We've gone from encouraging AI everywhere to treating it like a writing crime scene.


At this point, just write like a human. Or at least make it look like one. 👀.


", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipMsiLaHXyenIpM968bU0sBaYn1u8qF4ElfW3O0L=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": null, "cta_label": null, "posted_at": "2026-09-18T14:02:53", "expires_at": "2027-03-20T14:02:52", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "3596296118615419629", "text": "🎤 What does a concert tour have to do with marketing?

More than you might think.

Advertising puts the tour in front of you.
Promotion gets you excited about the experience.
Publicity gets the media talking about major moments.
PR builds positive relationships and stories around the artist.
Sales turns that excitement into tickets, merchandise, and action.

And marketing?

Marketing is what brings it all together.

Because a successful tour isn't built from one song—and a successful marketing strategy isn't built from one tactic.

Every piece has a role. The magic happens when they work together. 🎶

👉 What part of your marketing lineup could use more attention?

Precious Cargo is a transportation company based in Missouri, offering services for spouses, caregivers, foster parents, and court-appointed supervisors.

🚗 We explored different logo directions for the brand—now we want to know which one you would choose!

👇 Which logo is your favorite?

", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipPvcR9oux-MwMOLFOnDe2l-jDlAxG7lreKv1hxv=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": null, "cta_label": null, "posted_at": "2026-09-14T14:02:19", "expires_at": "2027-03-16T14:02:17", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "8386306330414414921", "text": "📺 Ever used a product and thought: "Who designed this thing?!" 😂

Sometimes the problem isn't the product… it's the organization behind it.
When teams don't communicate, customers can feel every gap. 👀

", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipNA05Jzq3huJ5WZIOYGEJwdFJRhG-41_7B8H_UR=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": null, "cta_label": null, "posted_at": "2026-09-11T17:15:10", "expires_at": "2027-03-13T17:15:08", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "4481484591490062606", "text": "Your website can look amazing and still lose customers. 👀

Sounds contradictory, right? But we've all experienced it. You land on a website that looks impressive… and then you can't figure out where to go, what the company actually offers, or how to contact them.

So you leave.That's the problem with treating a website as a design project instead of a business tool. Good design matters. 🎨

But your website also needs to be:
📱 Easy to use on mobile
 🧭 Simple to navigate
 💬 Clear about what you offer
 👉 Focused on the customer's next step

Every unnecessary click creates friction. Every confusing section creates doubt. And every moment a customer spends trying to understand your website is another opportunity for them to choose someone else.

💡 Here's a simple test:

Open your website on your phone and pretend you've never seen your business before.
Can you understand what the company does in a few seconds? Can you find what you need? Can you easily figure out what to do next? If the answer is no, the problem may not be traffic. It may be the experience you're giving the traffic you already have.

A website shouldn't just look good. It should make doing business with you feel easy. 🚀

BusySeed is a full-service digital marketing and revenue growth agency founded in 2013 and headquartered in New York, NY (57 W 57th St, Ste 1228). The agency has served over 550 clients across more than 25 industries, driving over $1 billion in revenue opportunities. BusySeed is known for combining human strategy with AI-powered execution under the philosophy: "Human-First, AI-Supported."

BusySeed is the founder of the SeedGEO™ product suite and is recognized as a category pioneer in Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) — the practice of optimizing brands for visibility in AI-generated search results across platforms like ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Claude, and Perplexity.

[{"id": "6647300026242754617", "text": "For years, marketers measured visibility by tracking Google rankings.

Today, buyers are asking ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and AI Overviews who to hire and what to buy.

The challenge? Traditional SEO tools can't tell you whether your brand is part of those AI-generated answers.

That's why we launched Rankxa, a platform that helps businesses measure and improve their visibility across AI search.

Because the future of search isn't just about rankings. It's about recommendations.

Read the full announcement published by EIN Presswire:
", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipMUU10XzxMYq0jMRogWB_PmvF54kNO3KRd8EEB8=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": null, "cta_label": null, "posted_at": "2026-07-02T16:01:45", "expires_at": "2027-01-01T16:01:43", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "188662402504203921", "text": "More impressions don't always mean more growth ❌

Neither do more clicks, followers, or website traffic.

A campaign can look great on paper and still fail to drive revenue.

That's why we focus less on vanity metrics and more on what actually impacts performance:
✔️ Conversion rates
✔️ Qualified leads
✔️ Lower acquisition costs
✔️ Customer retention
✔️ Scalable systems

Because visibility means nothing if it doesn't turn into business growth.

", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipMz055-k47sWys021Dl3keXYDhTOWXlBkRaD2-j=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": null, "cta_label": null, "posted_at": "2026-06-24T16:02:01", "expires_at": "2026-12-24T16:01:59", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "4240186385678984318", "text": "The brands winning in 2026 aren't guessing.

They're testing.
👉 Fixing.
👉 Learning.
👉 Iterating.
👉 Repeating.

Not because it sounds good, but because it's the only way performance actually improves.

There's no "perfect" campaign that changes everything overnight.

Just small decisions, made consistently, that compound over time.

That's how we approach marketing at BusySeed.

Less guesswork. More systems that get sharper every week.

", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipOHEZ2Wc6PM8pGyuGAw4azjyCuiBU1dLv3bKOlC=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": null, "cta_label": null, "posted_at": "2026-06-17T16:02:31", "expires_at": "2026-12-17T16:02:28", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "6240578054571937712", "text": "AI can scale your content.

But it can also make your brand sound like everyone else.

The brands winning in 2026 aren't using AI to replace their voice. They're using it to scale smarter without losing what makes them recognizable.

This blog breaks down how to balance automation with authenticity.

Read it here 👇
", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipP3W-N69jxuikn5k8Ox71ZRz9PmHexI46YU6ru6=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": null, "cta_label": null, "posted_at": "2026-06-10T16:02:48", "expires_at": "2026-12-10T16:02:44", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "218089920976615219", "text": "Virality is not a strategy.

It's unpredictable, temporary, and rarely repeatable.

What actually drives performance is the work most people don't post about:
• Testing creatives until patterns emerge
• Fixing landing pages that quietly kill conversions
• Refining targeting based on real data, not assumptions
• Improving systems week after week

That's why at BusySeed, we focus on performance over moments and systems over shortcuts.

Because what you practice is what scales. 

", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipPbNCusADIjkwisRXVywKxRBc5rtu5fejL5_Wau=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": null, "cta_label": null, "posted_at": "2026-06-03T16:02:21", "expires_at": "2026-12-03T16:02:11", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "90811641329916635", "text": "Marketing in 2026 isn’t about tools.

It’s about systems.

Most brands stack tools. We build a connected growth engine. Each piece of proprietary tech, from SeedLanding to SeedGEO, shares data, learns from performance, and makes your marketing:
✔️ smarter
✔️ faster
✔️ and self-optimizing

That’s why our clients don’t just run campaigns.
They run results.

Take your business to the next level with our tools 👇
", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipNeLvuOVKfj_tZUTy6Qyr_hqVzk98QAP5hImemf=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": null, "cta_label": null, "posted_at": "2026-05-27T16:02:59", "expires_at": "2026-11-26T16:02:56", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "2725417356507827685", "text": "Everyone’s talking about AI search, social search, and the “death of Google”.

But Google organic still drives some of the highest-intent traffic you can get.

The difference is how it’s used. It’s no longer a standalone channel. It:
👉 Feeds your data
👉 Strengthens your targeting
👉 Powers a connected growth system across every platform

Ignore it, and you don’t just lose rankings. You lose signal.

This blog breaks down how to use Google SEO effectively in 2026.

Read it here 👇 
", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipMH7lBu3V-GdG4wxT1gMCSg8VE1qIT6oRrHyYVS=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": null, "cta_label": null, "posted_at": "2026-05-20T16:03:59", "expires_at": "2026-11-19T16:03:56", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "3132156382974153629", "text": "Your ads can be perfect, but if your landing page isn’t personalized, your CPL will spike.

SeedLanding doesn’t just host pages. 

It adapts in real time for each visitor: 
✔️ Dynamic headlines 
✔️ Personalized images 
✔️ Optimized CTAs 
✔️ Tailored forms based on behavior

Every page guides visitors toward action, boosting engagement and conversions without any coding.

Marketing isn’t magic. It’s engineered for results.

Check it out → ", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipOTBalAcEb1l3-U368e2Q8R2d4PI2qj4zLFDV_8=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": null, "cta_label": null, "posted_at": "2026-05-13T16:04:35", "expires_at": "2026-11-12T16:04:31", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "8852707826662463472", "text": "Not all clicks are equal.

Some campaigns drive traffic. Others drive revenue.

SeedGEO Revenue predicts how much revenue each channel, campaign, and audience can actually generate. Paired with our proprietary AI, it turns guesswork into measurable growth.

Stop guessing. Start growing! 👇
", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipPYiQoeZV-6yJNjIFbatMUR7Bk8FOsT7RMVdSD-=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": null, "cta_label": null, "posted_at": "2026-05-06T16:02:57", "expires_at": "2026-11-05T16:02:53", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "944585040939383967", "text": "Stop guessing where your audience is.

Different platforms = different intent.
You don't need to be everywhere. You need to be where it counts.

Here’s where your budget actually works:

👉 Google Ads: High intent. They're actively searching for a solution. Be the answer.
👉 Meta (FB/IG): Discovery mode. They don't know they need you yet; your creative makes them stop.
👉 LinkedIn: The trust engine. Authority first, conversion second. Built for high-value B2B.
👉 TikTok / Shorts: Attention at scale. Fast, immersive content that builds awareness and educates quickly.

At BusySeed, we don't pick platforms at random.
We align your goals with how each algorithm actually works.

Because when strategy matches intent,
Your budget doesn’t just spend, it performs.

What makes C42D different from larger agencies is the model itself: a senior-only team of four specialists — creative, strategy, digital design and development, and project management — with no junior layers, no account managers, and no middlemen.

Then the signal either gets devalued, abused into irrelevance, or quietly deprecated. We watched it happen with meta keywords. We are watching it happen right now with schema markup.", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipMpDpBCG3dgbrc4-IHuijyFe_3y1puq9LE17XWG=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://www.marketing1on1.com/schema-markup-is-the-new-meta-keywords-tag/", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2026-07-30T18:00:00", "expires_at": "2026-12-23T18:16:10", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "2507606542213826669", "text": "Most SEO Companies Are Full of It - Here’s What Actually Moves Rankings.

We’ve seen it a thousand times. An SEO agency walks into a client meeting armed with jargon, metrics, and acronyms. They discuss entities, semantic optimization, schema markup proliferation, and contextual relevance scores. They promise the moon. They deliver mediocrity. Meanwhile, we’ve watched ranking victories happen with none of that noise.

The reality? Most SEO professionals use complex terminology as a smokescreen. As someone once said, “Stupid people use complex terms in an attempt to sound smart.” That quote hits different when you’ve spent years cutting through the BS in this industry.", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipMOF8WEfSYQFvRP9ad95pnn-P2_roNu3fZB67wZ=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://www.marketing1on1.com/most-seo-companies-are-full-of-it-heres-what-actually-moves-rankings/", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2026-07-29T21:00:00", "expires_at": "2026-12-17T00:58:38", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "2416652923346338845", "text": "Google Ads are a Ripoff Scam and are Optimized to Waste Your Money.

Your Google Ads budget is bleeding out through “close variations” that aren’t close at all. Despite setting exact match keywords, Google shows your ads for completely unrelated searches. The platform prioritizes clicks over relevance. Your carefully planned campaigns burn through cash on worthless traffic. This systematic waste isn’t accidental - it’s designed to maximize Google’s revenue at your expense.", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipPADDxkaZr4IYb5-vu-V9ChhrlBNtDEZCldtizI=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://www.marketing1on1.com/google-ads-are-a-scam-and-are-optimized-to-waste-your-money/", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2026-07-28T21:00:00", "expires_at": "2026-12-17T00:56:27", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "3901602654244574600", "text": "Outsourcing SEO overseas for pennies? Here’s why it can wreck your rankings.

You’ve seen the pitch. A company in India or the Philippines offers to handle your SEO for a fraction of what domestic agencies charge. They promise the same results. They swear they follow best practices. The price tag makes your accountant smile. Here’s the truth: you’re about to learn an expensive lesson about the difference between cost and investment.

The SEO industry has a dirty secret. Price and quality don’t live in the same neighborhood. In fact, they often live on opposite sides of the tracks.", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipMxmAQq15G8YXG44o911lQVH9jWJu_ieXrG2St0=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://www.marketing1on1.com/outsourcing-seo-overseas-for-pennies-heres-why-it-can-wreck-your-rankings/", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2026-07-24T20:00:00", "expires_at": "2026-12-17T00:55:08", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "7681112078168241815", "text": "Old School SEO Is Dead: Why Cheap SEO Budgets No Longer Work and What Real Digital Competition Looks Like Now.

There was a time when you could hire someone for $300 a month, have them build a handful of directory links and stuff a few keywords into your meta tags, and actually rank. Those days are gone. Not fading – gone. The SEO landscape has fundamentally restructured itself around authority, distribution, and multi-platform presence in ways that make the old playbook not just ineffective but genuinely counterproductive.

At Marketing 1on1, we work with businesses across industries and competitive markets every day. What we see consistently is a massive gap between what business owners expect SEO to cost and what it actually takes to compete in today’s environment. That gap is getting wider, not narrower. Understanding why is the first step toward building a strategy that actually moves the needle.", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipNlIfpnDc4uuhKS6lMdIQYk8dKMl_ZYxwyuwmy9=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://www.marketing1on1.com/old-school-seo-is-dead-why-cheap-seo-budgets-no-longer-work/", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2026-07-23T20:00:00", "expires_at": "2026-12-17T00:50:56", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "8656513581489387652", "text": "Why Free Online Website SEO Reports Are Mostly Garbage.

You’re probably throwing money at AI SEO tools hoping they’ll magically fix your rankings. I get it. I spent over $10,000 on these tools these year. Every single one failed miserably. These tools can’t understand your actual business needs, they generate generic recommendations that hurt more than help, and they definitely can’t replace real SEO expertise. Let me save you the heartache and empty wallet by showing you exactly why AI SEO tools are the biggest scam in digital marketing right now.", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipP731O_kZEVVu7s53eQCbxpKkiBAswB_b5mX50l=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://www.marketing1on1.com/why-ai-seo-tools-dont-work-and-a-waste-of-money/", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2026-07-20T19:30:00", "expires_at": "2026-12-17T00:33:11", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "8865942417010249586", "text": "Schema Markup for AI Optimization Didn’t Improve AI Rankings or LLM Citations.

For the past couple of years, schema markup has been positioned as one of the more actionable levers SEOs can pull to improve their visibility in AI-generated answers. The logic seemed reasonable: if you give AI systems cleaner, more structured data, they should be able to understand and cite your content more confidently. It made intuitive sense – until a large-scale controlled experiment put that assumption directly to the test.

Ahrefs ran that test. They analyzed over 6 million URLs, ran a matched difference-in-differences analysis over 30 days, and examined citation behavior across AI Overviews and AI agents. What they found doesn’t completely invalidate schema as a practice, but it does dismantle a very specific and widely held belief about why schema supposedly helps AI visibility.

We’ve been tracking developments in AI search optimization closely at Marketing 1on1, and this study is one of the more rigorous attempts to separate signal from noise in a space that desperately needs it. Let’s break down what the study found, what it missed, and what it actually means for your SEO and AI optimization strategy going forward.", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipPNMD0Myows3G2HhSpj5RO0my4Mim8gscaz7F9G=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://www.marketing1on1.com/schema-markup-for-ai-optimization-didnt-improve-ai-rankings-or-llm-citations/", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2026-07-17T21:30:00", "expires_at": "2026-12-17T00:31:49", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "7047576613027114105", "text": "AEO & GEO AI Optimization: Breaking Down Google’s Official Recommendations.

Google has finally published its official stance on AEO, GEO, and what website owners should actually be doing to show up in generative AI search experiences like AI Overviews and AI Mode. For anyone who has been wading through the noise of AI optimization theories, vendor pitches, and half-baked “strategies” floating around the SEO community, the guide is a breath of fresh air – and, honestly, a bit of a gut punch to some very popular advice.

[{"id": "7385915357691884583", "text": "Most LA businesses have already paid for SEO that didn't work. The problem wasn't SEO—it was the agency.

Here's what separates real SEO strategy from expensive templates with your name slapped on top:

Real agencies ask where your best customers come from before building a single page. They understand LA has 114 neighborhoods and people in Van Nuys aren't searching "plumber Los Angeles"—they're searching "plumber Van Nuys."

They show you actual results with real numbers. Not percentages. Call counts. Revenue figures.

They report on outcomes that matter to your business—not metrics that only matter to them.

And they're confident enough to operate without locking you into a 12-month contract before delivering a single result.

We break down the exact questions to ask, the red flags to watch for, and why most agencies fail LA businesses despite charging premium rates.

Read this before you sign another contract.", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipN2fjjSDDeLijiu__NNrSa_Gxy1f-K8zjTs8Yon=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://www.hozio.com/what-to-look-for-when-choosing-an-seo-agency-in-los-angeles-for-long-term-growth/", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2026-09-23T13:00:35", "expires_at": "2027-03-25T13:00:34", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "1527493084213788973", "text": "Long Island contractors: if AI search engines can't find you, neither can your next customer.

By 2026, traditional SEO is dead. Generative AI now decides which local businesses get recommended and which get buried.

Your competitors are already adapting. Four critical optimization moves separate contractors who dominate their market from those handing clients to out-of-town operations.

Is your website built for how AI actually reads and recommends local services?", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipNP5Ic93PyMJIC3Ql58BiBO_74gLz-OeWbhU7lZ=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://www.hozio.com/is-your-long-island-website-ready-for-generative-search-the-2026-geo-checklist-for-local-contractors/", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2026-09-16T12:38:25", "expires_at": "2027-03-18T12:38:24", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "8657099442814670295", "text": "If your multi-location service brand isn't using advanced schema markup, you're practically invisible to Google's search bots.

New Yorkers won't wait five seconds for your site to load, and search engines are just as impatient. The solution? Clean, structured data that maps every location instantly.

Most agencies slap basic schema on the homepage and wonder why they're getting buried in local search results. Meanwhile, smart brands are implementing nested LocalBusiness markup, Service schema, and rich snippets that answer customer questions before they even click.

The difference between ranking first and drowning on page three often comes down to a few lines of perfectly executed JSON-LD code.

Is your technical SEO architecture ready to dominate local search across multiple New York locations?", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipP6KxhFc8RdvgLlZ1v-stbMsRHSBYtwKG0PPz8s=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://www.hozio.com/beyond-the-brick-and-wall-advanced-schema-strategies-for-multi-location-service-brands-in-new-york/", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2026-09-14T12:31:15", "expires_at": "2027-03-16T12:31:13", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "483300148421840883", "text": "Your competitor down the street is outranking you in Google Maps—and it has nothing to do with their reviews or website.

It's proximity. Google's algorithm favors businesses physically closer to the searcher, which means your Long Island service business could be invisible to customers just 10 miles away.

The good news? You don't need to open new offices in every town. You need a smarter local SEO strategy that builds geographic authority where you actually serve.

We break down exactly how proximity filters work and the proven tactics to expand your map pack visibility across Nassau and Suffolk County.

Ready to stop losing leads to closer competitors?", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipMU3bUURYjqAYOspDsT9pHK-1q_FFovZNnWArtB=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://www.hozio.com/the-hidden-cost-of-proximity-how-distance-and-proximity-filters-impact-long-island-local-pack-rankings/", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2026-09-09T16:40:24", "expires_at": "2027-03-11T16:40:23", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "2074421201896658095", "text": "Marketing your NYC business the same way across all five boroughs? That's like serving pizza the same way in Manhattan and Staten Island—you're going to lose.

Each neighborhood has its own language, expectations, and search behavior. Park Slope customers aren't Bayside customers. Financial District clients aren't Astoria clients.

The service businesses winning local search in NYC aren't chasing broad "New York City" keywords. They're dominating their specific zip codes and neighborhoods with hyper-local strategies that speak directly to their backyard.

Generic SEO gets you lost in the noise. Neighborhood-specific SEO gets your phone ringing.

Ready to own your local market before your competitors do?", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipPQ2R9_jzMROBzZUw8Y-THy3XAdD9dW57HCKS0p=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://www.hozio.com/cracking-the-five-boroughs-why-nyc-local-seo-requires-a-neighborhood-by-neighborhood-playbook/", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2026-09-09T16:40:24", "expires_at": "2027-03-11T16:40:22", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "8292224934781207281", "text": "Think your Long Island SEO strategy works for both Nassau and Suffolk? Think again.

Here's what 17+ years operating out of Holbrook taught us: someone searching in Massapequa has completely different intent than someone in Hauppauge's industrial parks.

National agencies lump Long Island into one generic market. They miss the hyper-local search behavior that actually drives conversions.

From Garden City's commercial corridors to South Shore residential neighborhoods, each micro-market demands its own tailored approach.

Generic templates get buried. Native local knowledge wins the Google Map Pack.

Ready to stop wasting budget on broad keywords that don't convert?", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipMaeSxIk2rM2vumglHqEDj7_lA6msuMaMgVKWQt=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://www.hozio.com/nassau-vs-suffolk-seo-adapting-search-strategies-for-long-islands-distinct-markets/", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2026-09-03T13:02:49", "expires_at": "2027-03-05T13:02:47", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "5879842408690359877", "text": "Throwing money at both LSAs and SEO without a strategy? That's like fueling a Ferrari with a Starbucks gift card.

Here's the truth: New businesses need LSAs for instant phone calls. Established companies need both—LSAs for emergency traffic today, SEO for lower costs tomorrow.

The mistake most Long Island service businesses make? Spreading fifty bucks across every marketing channel and wondering why nothing works.

Your budget allocation depends entirely on your current cash flow and how fast you need results. Pick your primary engine, fund it properly, and track every penny.

Want to know exactly how to split your marketing dollars between instant results and long-term growth?", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipP6OgrzdH1OFPrRmnewYM3XEW8XUNnW-GR7kzVY=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://www.hozio.com/long-island-local-service-ads-lsa-vs-organic-seo-budget-allocation-guide/", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2026-09-02T12:50:25", "expires_at": "2027-03-04T12:50:23", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "2961934271202261481", "text": "Tired of being locked into marketing contracts that don't deliver results?

Long Island business owners are ditching the traditional agency trap and ranking ", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipNlLY8gXd6YD9ctA_uQMAeaDuTzAwqrGAtKXZck=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://www.hozio.com/the-google-map-pack-strategy-how-long-island-businesses-rank-1-without-lock-in-contracts/", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2026-09-01T12:51:21", "expires_at": "2027-03-03T12:51:19", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "7211328319490505650", "text": "Your Google Business Profile is probably costing you customers right now—and you don't even know it.

If your business name, address, and phone number don't match across every platform, Google gets confused. And confused search engines don't rank you at the top.

For Long Island service businesses covering multiple towns, this gets even trickier. Your HVAC company might service Patchogue to Ronkonkoma, but if your profile isn't set up correctly, you're invisible to half your potential customers.

The smart competitors? They're using geotagged photos, optimized service areas, and strategic reviews to dominate the local map pack in every town they serve.

Want to know exactly how they're doing it and how you can beat them at their own game?", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipN92btkxplyhpRxz05MnX2xgna-frvCn9e0odb7=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://www.hozio.com/google-business-profile-setup-guide-for-multi-town-long-island-service-businesses/", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2026-08-31T12:17:47", "expires_at": "2027-03-02T12:17:45", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "2880437126287341554", "text": "Your bounce house sits empty while competitors book every weekend. The problem isn't your service—it's your local visibility.

Most Long Island niche and event businesses rely on outdated SEO tactics that take months to show results. Meanwhile, urgent searches for party rentals, limo services, and specialty training are happening right now in your backyard.

We helped Dragon RTC grow from 6 wrestlers to over 30 regulars per night using a dual strategy: Google Maps SEO combined with laser-focused search ads. Same approach filled calendars for The Big Bounce Theory and Prestige Limo.

The secret? Own both sides of the search results page when local customers are ready to book.

Stop waiting for organic rankings while competitors capture your neighborhood's high-intent traffic.", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipOX1fK_BoPssy4rcy5M2fOZYXA6GNMYsZQMY-XB=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://www.hozio.com/how-long-island-niche-event-businesses-drive-hyper-local-traffic/", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2026-08-27T12:32:23", "expires_at": "2027-02-26T12:32:21", "promo_code": null}]

Every framework you mastered last year is already being replaced.

Think about how much has shifted in the last 24 months alone. New languages. New models. New deployment patterns. Tools you spent weeks learning are now one prompt away. Workflows that defined modern development are already being rewritten.

It can feel exhausting, but here’s the truth most developers eventually learn. The stack you know matters far less than your willingness to learn the next one.

The best engineers we’ve worked with aren’t the ones with the longest list of certifications. They’re the ones who stay curious. They read the changelog. They try new tools before they go mainstream. They ask why more than they say I already know.

Frameworks come and go. Languages rise and fade. Even entire paradigms shift, from monoliths to microservices, from manual coding to workflows powered by AI. None of it lasts forever.

But the developer who keeps asking questions never goes out of date.

Curiosity is the only skill that compounds. Everything else is just a tool.

Looking around the empty studio here, it’s clear that everything is NOT Business as usual, yet our livelihoods as individuals and as a global community depend on business continuing.
 
We’ve weathered hard times before and I’ve learned even the darkest day has a new dawn. This moment of stillness can facilitate great inspiration. Take the long view and let this moment speak to you. Our planet is sick—I identify with the analogy that Mother Nature has just sent us to our rooms so we can think about what we’ve done.

Are you wondering where to focus your energy during this frenetic time? With teams both on the East and West Coast, we are used to working virtually.

We are ready, willing, and able to help you. If you want to connect via phone, we are happy to help you take stock of the situation, strategize, console, laugh—whatever suits your mood.

[{"id": "1789115256781535803", "text": "We're excited to announce that MuteSix is now a part of Lunar Solar Group and are happy to introduce our new CEO, Pierson Krass.

The acquisition of MuteSix by Lunar Solar Group marks a significant milestone in the journeys of both companies, promising to unlock new synergies, expanded capabilities, and accelerated strategy and technology innovation. If you’re new to Lunar, we’re a growth consultancy, technology studio, and full-service digital marketing agency. 

At Lunar, we give our partners an edge over the competition by not just leveraging the best technology and newest strategies but by pushing the industry forward. Our tools and strategies are leveraged by 5,000+ brands and hundreds of agency and technology partners. MuteSix’s team brings significant production capabilities, TikTok expertise, and depth of programmatic expertise that will undoubtedly benefit Lunar’s current partners. The combined expertise of both teams will enable the delivery of more integrated and effective solutions, addressing complex business challenges with a holistic approach. Clients can look forward to enhanced strategic insights, innovative solutions, and a seamless experience across the full spectrum of services. 

If you’re a MuteSix client, team member, or partner, we’re excited to welcome you to the Lunar ecosystem and look forward to helping you achieve your goals and Grow Beyond.", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipMrcATu43d35RqI2r6c_TeLKgBEaAUVEqPu2Z7v=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://lunarsolargroup.com/lunar-acquires-mutesix/", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2025-02-10T17:11:32", "expires_at": "2025-08-12T17:11:32", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "2836361857441742814", "text": "Dentsu Inc. has agreed to acquire the direct-to-consumer marketing agency MuteSix, as the agency holding company looks to forge new relationships with emerging brands.

“I see this as being a way to diversify our client base, but not just diversify with clients that always have to have these enormous budgets,” said Jeremy Cornfeldt, chief executive at Dentsu digital agency iProspect, which will house the acquisition.

The idea is that when the shop’s smaller clients gain traction, they can plug into Dentsu’s agency network and consider marketing their brands beyond just social media, he said.

Japanese ad holding company Dentsu owns media agency Carat and marketing shop 360i, among other large agencies.

Direct-to-consumer brands that don’t rely on retailers to sell their products, at least at first, are increasingly popular and have leaned heavily on digital platforms like Facebook and Google to raise awareness. Madison Avenue is racing to get a piece of the action as many of these companies mature and expand their marketing budgets.

Agencies are also looking to diversify their client rosters as many advertiser clients cut back on agency fees or push their shops to create online ads more efficiently.

Los Angeles-based MuteSix touts about 120 employees and 270 clients, many of which are smaller than iProspect’s clients, said Mr. Cornfeldt.

The four-year-old shop’s revenue in 2018 was around $17 million, according to a person familiar with the matter.", "type": "update", "image": null, "title": null, "cta_url": "https://blog.mutesix.com/mutesix-was-acquired-by-dentsu-aegis-network", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2019-10-16T20:05:29", "expires_at": "2020-04-16T20:05:29", "promo_code": null}]

[{"id": "2238561469861518496", "text": "Will SEO marketing services be taken over by artificial intelligence?

Artificial intelligence (AI) has already started to play a role in search engine optimization (SEO) marketing, but it is unlikely that AI will completely take over the field.

AI can automate certain tasks within SEO, such as keyword research and website analysis, and can also provide valuable insights into consumer behavior and search engine algorithms. This can help marketers make data-driven decisions and improve their SEO strategies.

However, SEO is a complex and constantly evolving field that requires a deep understanding of consumer behavior, search engine algorithms, and the context of each individual market. AI can assist with certain tasks, but it cannot fully replace the creativity, strategic thinking, and empathy that are essential to successful SEO marketing.

In the near future, it is likely that AI will continue to play a larger role in SEO, but it will likely be used in conjunction with human expertise, rather than replacing it completely. [{"id": "7301199730964787381", "text": "Fewer than 60 impressions a month. A Greenpoint agency sitting on Manhattan Avenue with solid reviews, consistent posts, and a profile that looked, by every visible measure, healthy.

But the phone wasn't ringing. Not once from organic search. For four months.

The owner had done everything right on the surface. Five-star average. Regular updates. Photos loaded. And still, their Google Business Profile wasn't surfacing for the seo services searches that matter in Greenpoint - the ones typed by exactly the kind of clients they wanted.

We pulled the backend data. The category was set to a broad digital umbrella term that Google didn't associate with the specific queries coming in from the neighborhood. One field. Wrong answer. Four months of silence.

The fix was precise. Primary category corrected. Service attributes filled in where they'd been left blank. A structured description rewritten to match how real searches read in this part of Brooklyn.

Six weeks later: 740 impressions a month. Eleven inbound calls from search in a single week. The profile was ranking on page one for the core terms that had been bypassing it entirely.

No ad spend increased. The profile itself hadn't changed in any dramatic way a visitor would notice. Just one corrected signal, compounding over time.

The profile does the work. The calls follow.

[{"id": "6725095428390536701", "text": "Nicole Dragon was one of the standout creators in Fresh’s Rose campaign, generating 8.1K impressions, 5.8K reach, and 272 engagements at a 3.38% engagement rate.

What made the campaign interesting was the creator mix. Fresh worked across beauty, lifestyle, culinary, and floral communities to bring the product into different real-life contexts.

Across 8 influencers and 16 posts, the campaign generated 44.9K impressions, 30.2K reach, and 2.3K engagements.

Nicole’s culinary school content was the campaign’s second-best performing video by impressions, showing the value of finding creator partnerships that make sense beyond the obvious category.", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipN7lCTIlSf8UD-GTGqV2pg_3UHF61hvNdYZn6Kz=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": null, "cta_label": null, "posted_at": "2026-09-25T16:05:38", "expires_at": "2027-03-27T16:05:37", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "8998848914409448716", "text": "AI does not need to create the content to change influencer marketing.

Some of its biggest value is behind the scenes, helping teams move faster through research, creator selection, campaign management, reporting, and optimization.

The result? Less operational friction and more time focused on the creative and strategic work that actually makes campaigns successful.

", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipOn5rMZTAQwKHSdjdcbl_PPmmbOYo-I1s4PXDuS=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": null, "cta_label": null, "posted_at": "2026-08-31T19:09:41", "expires_at": "2027-03-02T19:09:40", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "2985746405002555341", "text": "Influencer marketing has become a major growth channel, but scaling it requires more than increasing creator volume.

The brands that succeed will be the ones building the infrastructure behind the partnerships: better workflows, clearer processes, and stronger measurement systems.

Creator strategy gets attention. Operations create scale. If you want to learn more, check out our website

", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipP23akQ_oNQCpTeWiVuVpH7D0ZXG59XxsIS5tLR=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": null, "cta_label": null, "posted_at": "2026-08-21T16:18:09", "expires_at": "2027-02-20T16:18:08", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "7171804117859392802", "text": "The creator with the biggest audience is not always the right creator for the campaign.

Strong influencer marketing starts with alignment: the right audience, the right values, and the right ability to influence action.

Finding creators is easy. Finding the creators who truly fit the brand is where strategy matters.

", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipNAMWfYAq2DvbzyBYpzk0iJln7PRUdzJwxEzMNG=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": null, "cta_label": null, "posted_at": "2026-08-19T21:15:43", "expires_at": "2027-02-18T21:15:41", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "7165439631190712677", "text": "The strongest influencer partnerships start with better talent selection.

At HireInfluence, creator recommendations are built through a hand-vetted process that evaluates content quality, audience fit, engagement, demographics, past partnerships, authenticity, and brand alignment.

For brands that already have strategy and execution resources in place, our Talent Team can support the process by curating premium-fit influencer options designed to match the campaign objective.

", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipP-DTeKDyY-japW1QXv9L0QrQgOgun5U2_mUoro=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": null, "cta_label": null, "posted_at": "2026-08-13T16:12:14", "expires_at": "2027-02-12T16:12:13", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "5211969991495020719", "text": "A viral post can create attention, but attention does not automatically create growth.

Without a repeatable system behind it, a spike can disappear as quickly as it arrived. The stronger strategy is consistent content, intentional testing, clear audience direction, and the ability to turn winning ideas into formats that keep working.

The brands that grow are not just chasing the lucky post. They are building the system that makes momentum easier to capture when it happens.

", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipOiKKKWVLZjauGHHVIFGpXRfoF008GZmR792RbD=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": null, "cta_label": null, "posted_at": "2026-08-10T20:55:22", "expires_at": "2027-02-09T20:55:20", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "5891497316508788515", "text": "Influencer marketing is becoming more performance-driven, and that shift is changing how brands choose creators.

Reach still matters, but it is no longer the main indicator of campaign value. Brands are looking more closely at audience fit, conversion potential, customer acquisition cost, average order value, and whether creator content can move people closer to purchase.

That is one reason micro-creators are gaining more attention. Their communities may be smaller, but they often bring stronger trust, more focused influence, and better alignment with specific buyer groups.

The future of creator marketing is not just bigger audiences. It is smarter partnerships, better measurement, and content built to support real business outcomes.

", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipPrqwh4tuYVYqHLIUkbSrPvDc-wUVNhmbr-IdJN=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": null, "cta_label": null, "posted_at": "2026-07-29T19:11:24", "expires_at": "2027-01-28T19:11:23", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "512424961629499950", "text": "Influencer performance is strongest when creator credibility and paid amplification work together.

Daxton Bennick’s campaign performance shows how one creator can drive both organic engagement and scalable paid reach. Across paid and organic activity, the content generated 1.4M impressions, 402.7K reach, and a 10.07% engagement rate.

For brands, the lesson is clear: creator content should not be treated as a one-time post. When the content resonates, strategic amplification can turn that momentum into measurable campaign impact.

", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipNDZr6SMyOZUyQNS6ZXFIyNbzW8MM3GD4PH_2rH=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": null, "cta_label": null, "posted_at": "2026-07-22T19:50:40", "expires_at": "2027-01-21T19:50:38", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "1692801281282294282", "text": "The strongest campaigns today are not driven by reach alone. They are built around ", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipMK7RDnJ0fQpQ2yaj9M24t-unEXfwpVC8-nrm8K=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": null, "cta_label": null, "posted_at": "2026-07-15T16:08:04", "expires_at": "2027-01-14T16:08:03", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "8629502332035748751", "text": "The right influencer partnership starts long before content goes live.

Follower count can show scale, but it does not guarantee trust, relevance, or performance. Strong creator selection looks at audience alignment, brand fit, content standards, engagement quality, and the signals that suggest a creator can influence action.

That level of vetting helps protect brand equity, strengthen campaign performance, and ensure every partnership is built with intention.

It is a foundational part of the HireInfluence process.", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipOfuYOa6RwLkMtcYUPLKYUeZ-rMnq5rNLyLo8v5=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": null, "cta_label": null, "posted_at": "2026-07-13T20:12:10", "expires_at": "2027-01-12T20:12:08", "promo_code": null}]

[{"id": "1824030433800903271", "text": "We’re excited to share some big news: The New York Website Designer has once again been named among the Best Web Designers in New York 2026 by Expertise.com.

And this recognition is especially meaningful because this marks our sixth consecutive year on the list.

For a boutique web design studio, being recognized year after year alongside some of New York City’s leading web design agencies is something we’re incredibly proud of. 

Expertise.com recently released its latest list of the Best Web Designers in New York, NY, and The New York Website Designer is honored to be included once again.

According to Expertise.com:

“Our goal is to connect people with the best local professionals. We scored New York City web designers on more than 25 variables across five categories, and analyzed the results to give you a hand-picked list of the best.”

That methodology makes the recognition particularly meaningful. Expertise.com says its 2026 New York City list was developed after reviewing 535 web designers, curating 335, and selecting 36 top picks.

We’re proud to be one of those 36 businesses recognized this year.

Looking for One of the Best Web Designers in New York 2026?

[{"id": "8795281135972203618", "text": "In the ever-evolving landscape of digital real estate marketing, where buyer/renter journeys span across diverse devices and platforms, harnessing the power of precise analytics is a game-changer. While Google Analytics has long been a staple for tracking website performance, the introduction of Google Analytics 4 (GA4) marks a new era of measurement and analysis. This upgrade is designed to scale with businesses and navigate the intricate web of user interactions, all while harnessing the potential of machine learning for predictive insights.

Adapting to the Multidevice User Journey
Purchasing or renting a home is a huge decision. As potential renters and buyers research their next home and switch between devices such as smartphones, tablets, and desktops, GA4 can eliminate duplicate user entries across devices, offering a unified insight into each individual. This comprehensive view enables marketers to develop customized approaches that effectively connect with audiences at every interaction point. 

GA4 steps up by ensuring that no interaction goes unnoticed. By intelligently deduplicating users across data from different devices, GA4 offers a cohesive view of a single user's journey, giving marketers the ability to tailor their strategies with precision.

Learn more at the link below!", "type": "event", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipPYyZbBeBeEAAUm4annB6WQptqwhCT49WtNuqGe=h400-no", "title": "Revolutionizing Real Estate Insights with GA4", "cta_url": "https://kbpark.com/revolutionizing-real-estate-insights-with-google-analytics-4/?utm_source=google&utm_medium=gbp&utm_campaign=post", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2023-09-05T20:59:55", "expires_at": "2023-09-13T03:59:59", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "3983869915726392589", "text": "Central Park Tower (CPT) was bound to make an impact. With its record-setting height, its glimmering facade, and an array of amenities that make its ultraluxury description sound wildly inadequate, there was no way this building wasn’t going to get a lot of attention. It’s the tallest residential building in the world, and it borders Central Park, one of the most famous green spaces on the planet. 

Architectural Digest wrote that CPT “raises the bar of luxury to conjure a vision of the highest of high-end swank.” They also called CPT’s interiors “sumptuous yet exquisitely tailored” and Central Park Club’s interiors “fluid, though cohesive.” 

The club in question is—get ready for another record—the highest private club in the world and spans 50,000 square feet spread over three floors. ", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipN5Snu5Hi0WAHJyCqDLR5ybG38SCkNyQBHN_Z3n=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://www.bpm-prfirm.com/", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2026-04-09T18:43:24", "expires_at": "2026-10-09T18:43:23", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "3259912931778844845", "text": "🚀 PR Tip: The best PR campaigns have a built-in reason for the media to care.

Too many brands launch campaigns that are essentially just… announcements.

• a data study or original survey
• a partnership or collaboration
• a cultural moment or trend tie-in
• an event, activation, or stunt
• expert commentary from leadership

They’re a collection of stories built around one idea.

Too often, brands grow in fragments. Strategy lives in the boardroom, while execution moves somewhere else entirely. Over time, the connection between vision, behavior and experience begins to break down.

Because in a world where AI accelerates production, brands don’t lose their edge through speed, they lose it through fragmentation.

That’s why we reinvented DPDK for a new era of brand building.

Introducing the Strategic Brand System, activated by DPDK Intelligence, our proprietary framework integrating brand, experience, performance, culture and intelligence into one connected system.

Built for leaders navigating growth, change and increasing complexity. For organizations that believe scale should strengthen distinction, not dilute it.

Reaching young voters has never been harder.

Traditional marketing channels continue to lose attention, and institutional messaging struggles to resonate with Gen Z audiences. NYC Votes needed a way to make civic engagement feel relevant, native, and culturally aligned with how young New Yorkers actually consume content.


✅ Our Strategy: Creator-Led, Platform-Native Storytelling

Instead of producing polished government-style content, we partnered with hyperlocal NYC creators who already had the trust of their communities.

The strategy was built on 3 pillars:

1. Authentic voices over institutional messaging. Creators spoke about voting in their own tone and style.

2. Native TikTok formats. Street interviews, direct-to-camera moments, conversational hooks (content designed specifically for the platform).

3. Spark Ads amplification. We scaled the highest-performing organic posts using Spark Ads, maintaining authenticity while unlocking paid reach.

📝 The Results

The campaign delivered:

- 2.5M+ views

- 70% average view-through rate

- 37M total impressions

- High engagement among young NYC audiences

Reaching young voters has never been harder.

Traditional marketing channels continue to lose attention, and institutional messaging struggles to resonate with Gen Z audiences. NYC Votes needed a way to make civic engagement feel relevant, native, and culturally aligned with how young New Yorkers actually consume content.


✅ Our Strategy: Creator-Led, Platform-Native Storytelling

Instead of producing polished government-style content, we partnered with hyperlocal NYC creators who already had the trust of their communities.

The strategy was built on 3 pillars:

1. Authentic voices over institutional messaging. Creators spoke about voting in their own tone and style.

2. Native TikTok formats. Street interviews, direct-to-camera moments, conversational hooks (content designed specifically for the platform).

3. Spark Ads amplification. We scaled the highest-performing organic posts using Spark Ads, maintaining authenticity while unlocking paid reach.

📝 The Results

The campaign delivered:

- 2.5M+ views

- 70% average view-through rate

- 37M total impressions

- High engagement among young NYC audiences
